drhp.business: BASF India manufactures and markets a wide portfolio of chemicals, including agricultural solutions, dispersions, performance chemicals, monomers, coatings, care chemicals, nutrition & health products, intermediates, and petrochemicals. The company serves diverse industries such as agriculture, automotive, construction, personal care, and pharmaceuticals, primarily in the Indian market while also generating export sales.
drhp.end_markets: Agriculture|Automotive OEM and refinish coatings|Industrial manufacturing|Personal care and nutrition|Construction and infrastructure
drhp.expansion: Capital expenditure incurred during the year aggregated to Rs. 2,132.1 million. The company is executing a demerger of its Agricultural Solutions business into BASF Agricultural Solutions India Ltd, expected to complete by end of 2026 / early 2027, subject to NCLT approval. The company has also approved the divestiture of its 100% shareholding in BASF India Coatings Private Limited to Carlyle Group companies, with closing planned during the second quarter of calendar year 2026. risks.note: Revenues and profitability of the Agricultural Solutions business were impacted by price erosion due to generic competition in corn and low sentiments for chillies, soya, and cotton produce, partially offset by new products.
risks.risk: Generic competition and price erosion in Agricultural Solutions

risks.note: Profitability in the Nutrition & Health business was impacted due to lower price realization driven by an oversupplied market and intense competition, despite higher volumes and product mix.
risks.risk: Oversupplied market and intense competition in Nutrition & Health

risks.note: Revenues in Performance Materials, Monomers, and Intermediates businesses were impacted by lower price realization, partially offset by higher volumes or reduced input costs, indicating margin pressure from pricing dynamics.
risks.risk: Lower price realization across multiple segments

risks.note: The demerger is subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including NCLT, and is expected to complete by end of 2026/early 2027; delays or failure to obtain approvals could disrupt the strategic restructuring.
risks.risk: Execution risk related to the demerger of the Agricultural Solutions Business

risks.note: Margins in the Coatings business were lower during FY 2025-26 due to one-time transition costs, highlighting potential for similar non-recurring expenses in other segments during strategic shifts.
The Intermediates business profitability was impacted by higher fixed costs, which could pressure margins if volumes do not recover or if cost structures remain inflexible.
